subject: how many users at any moment on a specific application - can I tell?

messages.author: 5117fd6c9c423ce1
messages.subject: how many users at any moment on a specific application - can I tell?
parts:
Hi folks -

I believe I properly understand that, with the Shiny server open source version, one instance of R is running for a given application, and any concurrent users of that application all use that one instance.  Do I have that right?  Now.  My question is, is there any way to 'tell', in server.R, that several users are .. well, using the app, and let a new user know that computation time may be slowed down?   I thought it would be really helpful to be able to inform a user that their calculation might, for instance, take longer on a 'heavy load' moment, vs when they are a single user.  Is this possible?

messages.author: bbc57ffa8a14ad13
messages.subject: Re: how many users at any moment on a specific application - can I tell?
parts:
Hi Cyndy,

The real solution here would be to use Shiny Server Pro, which includes tracking of how many users are active and offers the ability to scale a single application across multiple applications.

But if you were wanting to hack something together in the OS version, you could leverage the session$onSessionEnded() callback function to do something like this: https://gist.github.com/trestletech/9926129 -- it's an example applications that tracks the number of concurrent users.
